title: A Quiet World
text: For a thousand years the Runeveil has hung over the land, a ward woven from lantern light. Villages slept. Roads stayed safe.

title: The Veil Frays
text: Something ancient is pulling at its threads. Where the weave tears, monsters crawl through and the old rune-kings stir.

title: Thirty-Two Rifts
text: From Greenhollow Vale to the Throne of the First Rune, and on to the Edge of Unwriting, each zone hides a boss that holds a stolen thread.

title: One Lantern
text: You begin alone, with a single lantern. Complete quests along the road and allies will join you. Seven heroes may answer, but only five can fight at once. Gear them, and teach them twenty-one trades.

title: Adventure Never Sleeps
text: Fight, gather and craft. Your party keeps working while you are away, for up to twelve hours. Come back to a pile of loot.
